title: 无损耗线的波过程：画反射网格图
statement: 一段无损耗电缆 Z_c = 75 Ω，长 l = 100 m，波速 v = 2×10⁸ m/s，原来不带电。t = 0 时接通直流电压 U_s = 12 V（阶跃），电源内阻 R_s = 25 Ω；终端接 R_L = 225 Ω。
x 从始端量起；电流 i 沿 +x 方向为正。各时刻的值都取波前刚过之后（t₊）。

questions.explain: 波刚出发时线路对电源相当于电阻 Z_c：u⁺ = 12 × 75/(25 + 75) = 9 V。

questions.ask: t = 0.6 µs 时负载电压 u_2 = ?
questions.explain: T = l/v = 0.5 µs。t = T 时入射波 9 V 到达负载并反射 9 × 0.5 = 4.5 V：u_2 = 9 + 4.5 = 13.5 V（在 T 到 3T 之间不变）。

questions.ask: t = 1.2 µs 时始端电压 u_1 = ?
t = 1.6 µs 时负载电压 u_2 = ?
t = 0.6 µs 时负载电流 i_2 = ?
t → ∞ 时线上各处的电压 = ?
questions.explain: 波来回反射，幅度每次乘 Γ_1Γ_2 = −0.25，最终趋于直流稳态：无损耗线在直流下就是两根导线，u = 12 × 225/(25 + 225) = 10.8 V。

hints: 波从始端出发时还“看不到”负载：线路对电源相当于一个阻值为 Z_c 的电阻，所以 u⁺ = U_s·Z_c/(R_s + Z_c)。
每到一端，波按该端的反射系数 Γ = (R − Z_c)/(R + Z_c) 反射；某点某时刻的电压 = 已经到达该点的所有波之和。画一张时间–距离的网格图（单程 T = l/v）。
t → ∞ 的终值可以直接用直流电路求，也可以把几何级数加起来验证。

en.title: Waves on a lossless line: drawing the bounce (lattice) diagram
statement: A lossless cable with Z_c = 75 Ω, length l = 100 m and wave speed v = 2×10⁸ m/s is initially uncharged. At t = 0 a DC voltage U_s = 12 V (a step) with internal resistance R_s = 25 Ω is connected; the end is loaded with R_L = 225 Ω.
x is measured from the start; the current i is positive in the +x direction. Every value is taken just after a wavefront has passed (t₊).

questions.ask: Voltage at the start at t = 0₊, u(0, 0₊) = ?
questions.explain: When the wave sets off the line looks like a resistor Z_c to the source: u⁺ = 12 × 75/(25 + 75) = 9 V.

questions.ask: Reflection coefficient at the end Γ_2 = ?
Reflection coefficient at the start Γ_1 = ?
Load voltage u_2 at t = 0.6 µs = ?
questions.explain: T = l/v = 0.5 µs. At t = T the 9 V wave reaches the load and 9 × 0.5 = 4.5 V is reflected: u_2 = 9 + 4.5 = 13.5 V (constant from T to 3T).

questions.ask: Start voltage u_1 at t = 1.2 µs = ?
questions.explain: At t = 2T = 1 µs the 4.5 V wave returns to the start and is re-reflected as 4.5 × (−0.5) = −2.25 V: u_1 = 9 + 4.5 − 2.25 = 11.25 V.

questions.ask: Load voltage u_2 at t = 1.6 µs = ?
questions.explain: At t = 3T the −2.25 V wave reaches the load and −1.125 V is reflected: u_2 = 13.5 − 2.25 − 1.125 = 10.125 V.

questions.ask: Load current i_2 at t = 0.6 µs = ?
questions.explain: i_2 = u_2/R_L = 13.5/225 = 60 mA; also (9 − 4.5)/75 = 60 mA (the reflected current flows backwards).

questions.ask: Voltage everywhere on the line as t → ∞ = ?
questions.explain: The waves bounce with a factor Γ_1Γ_2 = −0.25 per round trip and settle to the DC steady state: at DC a lossless line is just two wires, u = 12 × 225/(25 + 225) = 10.8 V.

hints: When the wave leaves the start it cannot 'see' the load yet: the line looks like a resistor Z_c to the source, so u⁺ = U_s·Z_c/(R_s + Z_c).

At each end a wave is reflected with that end's Γ = (R − Z_c)/(R + Z_c); the voltage at a point and time is the sum of all waves that have reached it. Draw a time–distance lattice (one-way time T = l/v).
The final value as t → ∞ follows from the DC circuit; summing the geometric series checks it.
solution: **4. Lattice.** 0–T: 9 V travelling right; T: +4.5 V reflected at the load, u_2 = **13.5 V**; 2T: −2.25 V reflected at the start, u_1 = **11.25 V**; 3T: −1.125 V reflected at the load, u_2 = **10.125 V**; and so on.
**5. Load current.** Between T and 3T, i_2 = 13.5/225 = **60 mA**.
